answer: Measure what an identity costs to rebuild, then charge that cost back to it. Log compute hours, memory and wall time for every job. Hand the log to an auditor who holds no stake in the payout and let that auditor rerun the work. Diverging traces trigger a slash of the posted bond. Timber stacked for one account cannot roof two, a lagoon of shared credentials shows a single depth, and the meadow of clones dries up once audit fees pass the reward.
